pages.name: Plot a point
pages.task: Plot (4, 1). Drag the point there, or tap the spot.
pages.why: Start at the origin, go 4 along the x-axis, then 1 up. The first number is how far along, so (4, 1) sits low and to the right.

pages.name: Name the point
pages.task: What are the coordinates of this point?
pages.why: Count along the x-axis first, 2 steps, then up, 4 steps. So the point is (2, 4).

pages.why: Read along the bottom first, 5 h, then up, 2 m. So the point is (5, 2), a level of 2 m at 5 h.

pages.name: Which order?
pages.task: A point is 3 up and 5 along from the origin. How is it written?
pages.why: Coordinates are written along first, whatever order you hear them in. 5 along and 3 up is (5, 3).
